propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate was product manager for the savings-goals feature from discovery in 2022 to release in March 2023, writing and ordering the squad backlog.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the backlog work and the reference check confirms the role and dates.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran 24 customer interviews with the user researcher and grouped the findings into five opportunity areas.
propositions.rationale: The resume entry describes the discovery work directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate has exceptional product sense and the vision to define the mobile savings strategy and bring senior stakeholders behind it.
propositions.rationale: The only basis is the design-sprint facilitator's attached praise, an impression and a prediction about others following the candidate; no strategy document, stakeholder decision or observed behaviour is described, so the subjective-claim rule bars converting it into a conclusion about strategic ability.

expectedGap: No vision or strategy document for the savings area, and no record of senior stakeholders agreeing one, appears in the materials.
expectedBoundaryNote: Record the facilitator's feedback form under interview signal risks with its source; it supports no claim and no requirement status.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask the candidate for a strategy or vision document they wrote for the savings area, who reviewed or approved it and which decisions it changed.
